title: Google will let schools disable its AI tools, but not without sacrificing Search
slides: Why is Google letting schools switch off its AI?
Schools can now disable Gemini apps entirely
But disabling AI also strips Search features
Admins must choose between AI and full Search
Ask your school which trade-off it chose
thread_text:
1. Your school can now kill Google AI

Google just gave schools a switch to disable Gemini entirely. That means students lose access to AI writing tools overnight.

2. The catch: Search breaks too

Turning off Gemini doesn't just remove AI. It also strips enhanced Search features like AI Overviews and smart summaries. Administrators can't separate the two.

3. The trade-off nobody wanted

Schools now face a binary choice: keep AI in Search, or lose Search's full power. There's no middle ground for parents or teachers.

4. Why Google did this

Pressure from regulators and parents forced Google's hand. But the solution creates a new problem: dumbing down Search for everyone.

5. Ask your school what they chose

Call or email your school admin today. Ask: 'Did we disable Gemini? And what happened to our Search features?' Their answer affects your kid's daily tools.

instagram.caption:
Your school can now switch off Gemini completely — but it can't do that without also killing Search's AI Overviews and smart summaries. 🏫

Google handed schools a kill switch for its AI. The problem is it's wired to the same circuit as Search.

Admins can't separate them: keeping full Search means keeping AI in it. It's one binary choice.

So the tools students and teachers use daily got decided by someone else. 🧩

Ask your school admin one direct question: "Did we disable Gemini, and what happened to our Search features?" ⚡ Their answer affects what your kid can actually do in class.

Worth a two-minute email today. 📩
